source_checklist.locator: NEB LV UDI primer sets E3390 et al., https://www.neb.com/en/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale3390_e3392_e3400_e3402_e3404_e3406_e3408

pass_1.locations: Official NEBNext LV Unique Dual Index Primers manual v1.0_11/24, online PDF pp. 1–5 (lines 1–59, 99–130), index Tables 1.1–1.7; original manual inspected independently of the first review
pass_1.finding: The manual explicitly lists E3390/E3392 and E3400–E3408 sets, names E8015 as a compatible library-prep kit, and prints per-well expected eight-base i7 and i5 index reads. Set 2A and 2B are subsets of Set 2, so they should not be pooled with it. These expected index reads do not identify the chosen well or print the complete primer synthesis strands.

pass_2.locations: Official NEB LV UDI manual v1.0_11/24 PDF https://www.neb.com/en/-/media/nebus/files/manuals/manuale3390_e3392_e3400_e3402_e3404_e3406_e3408.pdf, web lines 18-39, 141-197 and Tables 1.1–1.7
pass_2.finding: Manual provides i5/i7 8-base expected index-read sequences by well and pooling rules. It does not prove which well a given E8015 experiment chose or full primer synthesis strands.

pass_1.locations: Cited manual version, current official revision, separate UDI kit link.

pass_2.locations: E8015 v2.0_7/26 official manual lines 38-62, 359-370; LV UDI official manual lines 18-39 and 141-197
pass_2.finding: Followed E8015 into separately sold UDI manual and recovered per-well index reads. June 2025 E8015 revision cited by note still unavailable; July 2026 manual internally mislabels E3390/E3392 as E3900/E3902 in Fig.1 caption. Independent first-pass UDI check agrees; historical June 2025 E8015 revision remains unavailable.

missing_claims.claim: Full conversion-resistant ligation adapter and PCR primer strands
missing_claims.evidence: Cited June 2025 manual absent; current revision only gives motifs in inspected pages.

conclusion: July 2026 E8015 manual and linked LV UDI index manual are readable; current-manual discrepancy and per-well index table have independent checks. June 2025 cited revision remains unavailable.

bounded_checks.findings: Added omitted DNA denaturation (formamide recommended or 0.05 N NaOH, 85C 10min) as a strand-separation step feeding APOBEC; added lambda/pUC19 control spike-ins, UltraShear/Covaris fragmentation (~350 bp, no cleanup), Stop Reagent, three bead clean-ups (1X post-ligation with Carrier DNA at <=10 ng, 1X post-protection, 0.8X post-PCR) with waste fates, no cleanup between deamination and PCR, Q5U 4-14 cycles. Adaptor-ligated/protected/deaminated intermediates no longer drawn as the P5/i5/i7/P7 PCR product. Adaptor end changed to unavailable: manual does not print a 3'-dT end or call the adaptor conversion-resistant. Selftest checks both printed trimming sequences against the drawn library. Discrepancy E3390/E3392 vs Fig.1 E3900/E3902 re-verified at lines77 and 121 vs Fig.1 caption line128; uncertainty text corrected (no 'June 2025' revision exists in revision history). Removed unused legacy STEPS/Row panels. ref/MANIFEST.md revision corrected to 2.0_7/26.
